info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary:
listConnectors lists every connector with the caller org's real ingested-doc count.
A provider that is configured but not yet connected appears as "disconnected", so
the console can offer a Connect button.
get.description:
listConnectors lists every connector with the caller org's real ingested-doc count.
A provider that is configured but not yet connected appears as "disconnected", so
the console can offer a Connect button. No secret is ever returned.

get.summary:
listCatalog returns every connector this deployment offers, sorted by provider.
configured reports whether OAuth credentials are present, so the console shows
Connect or a "not configured" hint.
get.description:
listCatalog returns every connector this deployment offers, sorted by provider.
configured reports whether OAuth credentials are present, so the console shows
Connect or a "not configured" hint. Metadata only — no secret and no org state.

delete.summary:
disconnectConnector revokes a connection and de-indexes what it ingested.
The KMS credential is tombstoned (overwritten with empty — the KMS client has
no delete) so a later sync cannot reuse it, this provider's points are removed
from the org's vector namespace, and the connector document is marked
disconnected.
delete.description:
disconnectConnector revokes a connection and de-indexes what it ingested.
The KMS credential is tombstoned (overwritten with empty — the KMS client has
no delete) so a later sync cannot reuse it, this provider's points are removed
from the org's vector namespace, and the connector document is marked
disconnected. The ingested kb-source documents stay in the store — they are the
org's own data, deletable through the framework CRUD surface — but are no
longer retrievable by search. Everything is org-scoped.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the connector id from the path (slack, github, google, …).

get.summary: connectCallback completes the OAuth exchange and records the connection.
get.description:
connectCallback completes the OAuth exchange and records the connection.
The org is recovered from the SIGNED state, not a header, so an attacker cannot
land their token in a victim org; the token itself goes to KMS, never the
document or the logs.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the connector id from the path.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code is the provider's authorization code, exchanged for a token.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State is the value connect signed; the org is recovered from it, never a header.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error is set by the provider when the user denied consent.

get.summary:
connectStart returns the provider authorize URL the console sends the user to.
The state it carries is signed for the CALLER's org, so the token the callback
stores can only ever land in that org.
get.description:
connectStart returns the provider authorize URL the console sends the user to.
The state it carries is signed for the CALLER's org, so the token the callback
stores can only ever land in that org. Nothing is stored yet.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the connector id from the path (slack, github, google, …).

post.summary:
syncConnector pulls a provider's documents into the caller org's knowledge.
The token is read from KMS and the documents land as kb-source pages the index
picks up.
post.description:
syncConnector pulls a provider's documents into the caller org's knowledge.
The token is read from KMS and the documents land as kb-source pages the index
picks up. A provider-side failure answers 502 and the connector is left in
status "error" with the reason recorded.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider is the connector id from the path (slack, github, google, …).

get.summary:
graph returns the caller org's knowledge as a node/edge graph for a renderer.
Nodes are pages, memories, sources and connectors; edges are the parent tree,
the wikilinks and the connector provenance.
get.description:
graph returns the caller org's knowledge as a node/edge graph for a renderer.
Nodes are pages, memories, sources and connectors; edges are the parent tree,
the wikilinks and the connector provenance. A store outage degrades to an empty
graph with degraded=true, never a 5xx.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project narrows every node to that project scope; empty means the whole org.

post.summary:
search runs an org-scoped semantic retrieval over the org's knowledge namespace.
The org comes from principal.Org (a validated principal), so cross-tenant
retrieval is impossible: the collection AND the payload filter are both pinned to
this org.
post.description:
search runs an org-scoped semantic retrieval over the org's knowledge namespace.
The org comes from principal.Org (a validated principal), so cross-tenant
retrieval is impossible: the collection AND the payload filter are both pinned to
this org. An unreachable/disabled index returns an honest empty result set, never
a 5xx — the RAG caller degrades to no-context rather than failing the turn.

connectors.description: Connectors is one entry per known provider, connected or not.

account.description: Account is the connected account label; absent until first connected.

configured.description: Configured reports whether this deployment holds OAuth credentials for it.

docCount.description: DocCount is a live count of this provider's ingested documents in the org.

error.description: Error is the last sync failure; absent until first connected, empty when clean.

kind.description: Kind is "native" (a Go connector) or "piece" (an activepieces connector).

lastSync.description: LastSync is when the last sync finished; absent until first connected.

status.description: Status is disconnected | connected | syncing | error.

name.description: the document name (empty for synthetic nodes)

degraded.description: Degraded is true only when the document store was unavailable.

edges.description: Edges are the parent tree, the wikilinks and the connector provenance.

nodes.description: Nodes are the pages, memories, sources and connectors.

provider.description: Provider is the connector id from the path (slack, github, google, …).

doctypes.description:
DocTypes restricts retrieval to a subset of kb-page, kb-memory, kb-source.
An empty or foreign list means all indexed knowledge doctypes.

limit.description: Limit bounds the hits returned; default 10, max 50.

project.description: Project narrows retrieval to one project scope.

query.description: Query is the natural-language question. Required.

degraded.description: Degraded is true only when retrieval was unavailable and hits is empty.

hits.description: Hits are the matching documents, best score first.

ingested.description: Ingested is how many documents this sync filed into the org's knowledge.

provider.description: Provider is the connector that was synced.
